capabilities: Fade the 5 lines above and below the cursor
React to cursor movement and typing
Toggle fading on and off with a command
Bind a hotkey to the toggle
extras: README includes a manual installation guide for when the plugin does not appear in the community plugin search.
motivation: The author built it to help focus while writing in Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visually dim surrounding lines to keep attention on the line being edited.
summary: Focus mode that fades the five lines above and below the cursor so the current line stands out while writing.
